strategyReview: Live signals remain healthy: ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO wins 4/4 with +4.49% avg, PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW (AMZN disabled) is profitable (+0.14% avg clean), and PC_RATIO_EXTREME_HIGH (BTC disabled) is slightly positive. Weekend HL funding reversion long continues to dominate with 72% win rate and +1.12 total PnL. FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG overall is losing but the GOLD subset (60% win, +0.03 total) is positive; FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT OIL is weak but AMZN short shines at 73% win. Failure spots include NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW (42% win, -1.16), polymarket proxy shorts on PC ratio and funding signals (0-20% win), and one-touch NO trades on wide-spread contracts which frequently produce losses.

failureClusters.theme: Wide PM Spreads Erode One-Touch NO Edge
failureClusters.evidence: Recent resolved ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadows with wide_pm_spread flags show losses: GOLD -3.26% (yesSpread 0.02), BTC -1.04% and -1.25% (spreads ≥ 0.01). Wins cluster on tight spreads ≤0.01. Open quality warnings also flag wide spreads.
failureClusters.recommendation: Filter out contracts with yesSpread > 0.01 before considering the edge signal; reinforce exit when sell-YES edge disappears. This prevents the engine from entering positions where the edge is illusionary due to illiquidity.

failureClusters.theme: No Bias Adjusted Gap Shadows Unprofitable
failureClusters.evidence: NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW resolved 89 shadows, 42% win, aggregate PnL -1.1567. Includes large tail losses (e.g., BTC short -51.79, GOLD short -8.60). Even the best sub-cluster (short-rich-tail GOLD) only reaches 62% win.
failureClusters.recommendation: Disable NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW entirely as a shadow signal. Use the positive sub-cluster (FIND-0001) only if further research adds confirming conditions from funding/IV, otherwise allocate no live capital.

failureClusters.theme: Polymarket Proxy Shorts Underperform Base Signals
failureClusters.evidence: PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT (0% win, -0.57 total) and FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT (20% win, -0.33 total) severely underperform the direct perp/spot signals. The proxy mapping destroys edge.
failureClusters.recommendation: Suspend all polymarket proxy short mapping for PC ratio and funding signals. Accept only direct perp/spot execution for those families until a more reliable proxy mechanism is demonstrated.

newHypotheses.description: OIL one-touch NO edge on heatmap cluster: short OIL by selling YES on upside one-touch NO contracts when sell-YES edge > 2 points and the YES market spread is at most 1.5c. This targets the heatmap/no subcluster identified in FIND-0018 with high win rate.
newHypotheses.prediction: The YES price will decline as the edge corrects within 7 days, yielding a profitable NO position.

newHypotheses.description: OIL one-touch NO edge on near-fair cluster: short OIL by selling YES on upside one-touch NO contracts when sell-YES edge is between 1.5 and 2.5 points and liquidity is healthy, per FIND-0019's near-fair/no subcluster.
newHypotheses.prediction: Near-fair edges revert toward zero, causing the NO side to profit within a short horizon.

newHypotheses.description: GOLD no-bias gap short on rich-tail cluster: short GOLD perp when gold_hl_funding_ann is deeply negative (tail-short crossing) and the no-bias gap shadow detects a significant fair-value gap. This mirrors the GOLD short-rich-tail/no cluster from FIND-0001.
newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD price will revert lower as the funding extreme exhausts and the gap closes within 5 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Gold PM premium/futures spread mean reversion: shadow tests show 100% win rate over 3 tests. The thesis that PM IV compression below 16% while options IV stays above 30% creates reversion is holding. Recent gold spot moved 2.99% (4014 → 4134) per one test, validating the directional reversion. Continue shadow testing to build sample size before considering promotion.

Oil P/C ratio panic exhaustion reversal: 100% win over 12 shadow tests. This suggests extreme P/C ratio above 30 fading to below 3 is a reliable contrarian bounce signal. The hypothesis should be re-evaluated for promotion to a live signal family once the contamination rules are fully resolved for Oil.

BTC PM IV regime-relative compression: 100% win over 12 tests. The condition that PM IV is in the bottom 20% of its 30d range and at least 2 standard deviations below its mean is predicting spot upward moves. This is likely to become a promotable setup family after more shadow validation.
